selection: nearest common target among all-failed cases, then smallest case IDs with differing Rule 2/3 endpoints; three distinct cases
single_factor_design: Increase DLS budget per candidate while keeping .99/1.01 progression thresholds fixed. Do not call this a stage-step-budget experiment. Verify supported SDK cycle modes before choosing execution implementation.
separate_experiment: Relaxing .99/1.01 is a continuation-resolution experiment, must be reported separately from DLS budget.
baseline: Use matching V1 data for historical comparison, and repeat 50-cycle controls under the new run environment before attributing timing or small numerical differences.
operational_requirement: Additional calls use the same candidate and current optimized prescription without restoring between calls; validation and continuation advancement only after the allocated calls. This probes additional DLS passes and includes call-restart effects; it is not a fixed 100/200-cycle single call.
